description:
Base on-chain read: a contract's event logs, filtered by topic and block range. Event logs on Base: takes address (contract, 0x + 40 hex), optional topic0 (event signature hash, 0x + 64 hex) and optional blocks (last N blocks, 1-100, default 10), and returns the matching eth_getLogs entries.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/base_eth_getlogs. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
